news.headline: Why HPE's Financing Warning Is Pulling CoreWeave, IREN, and Nebius Lower After Nvidia's Rally
news.summary: On HPE's earnings call CEO Antonio Neri said HPE Financial Services has not provided financing to neocloud or high-risk customers, reviving worries about how Nebius will fund its $40-45B 2027 capex plan. Nebius fell about 11% to roughly $77, close to its 52-week low of $73.52.

news.headline: Nebius Group drops 11% amid broad technology selloff
news.summary: Nebius fell 11-12% on Nov 25 and moved back toward its 52-week low as AI stocks sold off for a second day: Nvidia's post-Huang-reinstatement rally fizzled and a hot inflation print revived rate worries. Worries about AI-infrastructure spending and debt hit the neocloud group hardest, and CoreWeave's 2031 bond yield rose to almost 18%. Nebius itself released no news.

news.headline: Nebius sinks 43% in a month on delays and soaring capex; CFO calls 2027 timing 'very, very conservative'
news.summary: The stock has lost about 43% in a month after the Q3 report pushed the $7B ARR milestone to February and raised capex to about $27B for 2026 and $40-45B for 2027. Management says the 2027 capacity timing assumptions are very conservative, which leaves room for upside if power deliveries come in on schedule.

news.headline: Why Is Nebius Stock Surging on Monday?
news.summary: Nebius rose almost 28% in regular trading on Monday, intraday as high as about $110, as AI-infrastructure stocks rebounded from the Nasdaq's worst week since 2020. The trigger was Nvidia's board reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he resigned, which lifted the whole neocloud group.

news.headline: Nebius rallies despite new U.S. curbs threatening neocloud business in Southeast Asia
news.summary: The rebound came even as a new U.S. policy restriction on AI-cloud activity in Southeast Asia took shape, a potential drag for neocloud providers serving that region. Nebius, CoreWeave and IREN had each lost more than a quarter of their value the week before.

news.headline: Freedom Capital Markets maintains Nebius at Buy, keeps $314 price target
news.summary: Freedom Capital Markets kept its Buy rating and $314 target despite the post-earnings guidance trim and capex increase, one of the most bullish calls on the Street and roughly three times Monday's price.

news.headline: Michael Burry Says He Tried to Warn You About Nebius. The Stock Just Crashed 16% and Is 72% Below Its Record
news.summary: Nebius closed Friday at $81.31, down 16% on the day after a 9% drop Thursday, leaving it about 72% below its June 18 record close of $286.69. The fading Anthropic-IPO bounce, neocloud debt worries and Michael Burry's bear posts drove the selloff.

catalysts.label: ARR to pass $7B
catalysts.detail: Management now expects annualized run-rate revenue to exceed $7B in February 2027, slipping from the original year-end 2026 target of $7-9B after data-center power delays.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results and first 2027 targets
catalysts.detail: Expected around February (date not announced). This is the first report under the new framework of revenue, pre-tax earnings and capacity targets instead of ARR; watch delivery against the low end of the $3.0-3.4B FY26 range and the $40-45B 2027 capex plan.

catalysts.label: Meta dedicated capacity ramp
catalysts.detail: The expanded Meta contract (base ~$12B, up to ~$27B) starts delivering dedicated AI compute across multiple sites in early 2027.

catalysts.label: Lappeenranta (Finland) 310MW AI factory first capacity
catalysts.detail: First capacity at the ~$10B multi-building campus is expected to reach customers in 2027.

catalysts.label: NEOM Oxagon capacity (up to 50MW)
catalysts.detail: Phased go-live from Q4 2027 under a preliminary HUMAIN/DataVolt framework; a binding offtake agreement is still pending.

catalysts.label: Israel 134MW Mega Or capacity (Beit Shemesh, Masmiya)
catalysts.detail: Landlord Mega Or targets completion of both sites by end of Q2 2028, adding to the earlier 8MW Modi'in and 80MW Israeli leases.

pulse: Nebius delivered a big Q3 beat on Nov 12 (revenue $981M, +571%; adj. EBITDA $466M), but power delays at a colocation partner pushed the $7B ARR milestone to February, 2026 revenue was steered to the low end of guidance and capex was raised to ~$27B (2027: $40-45B). Since then the stock has traded as a high-beta proxy for AI-infrastructure sentiment: down to $81 on Nov 20, up about 24-28% on Nov 23 after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, then down 13% on Nov 24 and another ~11% on Nov 25 after HPE's CEO said its financing arm does not lend to neoclouds, reviving funding worries around the $40-45B 2027 capex plan, leaving it near its 52-week low and about 43% lower in a month. The bull case rests on the Meta and Microsoft contracts and on management calling its 2027 capacity timing very conservative. The next hard data point is the Q4 report and first 2027 targets around February.
